subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: Happiness is something (a) ⎯⎯ we cannot describe in words. It can only be felt from someone’s positive expression. (b) ⎯⎯ contentment is the key to happiness. Contentment varies from person to person. (c) ⎯⎯, a beggar may be contented with ten taka. (d) ⎯⎯ a wealthy person may be unsatisfied even after getting one million taka. (e) ⎯⎯. it is said that contentment brings happiness.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) that/which (b) In fact (c) For example/For instance (d) On the contrary/On the other hand/But (e) Hence/So/For this reason/This is why
